page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing a Hygon 7447v processor running at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This server type does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. The underlying Hygon processor operates with a single thread per core and does not expose advanced instruction sets such as AVX, AVX-512, AMX, or hardware-accelerated AES cryptography flags.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a predictable compute-centric profile without the overhead of hyperthreading. This makes the instance suitable for workloads requiring dedicated CPU execution resources, such as web serving, batch processing, and lightweight compute tasks that do not rely on specialized vector or matrix instruction sets.
